_note: Source of truth for the Shopify catalogue (PRD-01 §3). The seed script reads this and upserts by handle, so it is idempotent and re-runnable against any store (PRD-01 §10). replenishment_days appears at product level per §3.2 AND per variant, because a 100ml and a 200ml of the same oil genuinely deplete at different rates and §F3.4 predicts next-order-date from this number.

products.title: Bhringraj Anti-Hairfall Hair Oil
products.description: A slow-infused bhringraj and sesame oil for thinning hair and a restless scalp. Massage into the scalp twice weekly, leave for at least an hour, then wash out. Most people notice less fall between weeks six and eight.
products.ingredients: Sesamum indicum oil, Eclipta alba (bhringraj) extract, Cocos nucifera oil, Emblica officinalis, Rosmarinus officinalis oil, tocopherol.

products.title: Rice Water Strengthening Shampoo
products.description: A sulphate-free wash built on fermented rice water, which coats the shaft with inositol and reduces breakage over time. Gentle enough for daily use, and it will not strip colour.
products.ingredients: Aqua, fermented Oryza sativa extract, cocamidopropyl betaine, coco-glucoside, panthenol, Aloe barbadensis, citric acid.

products.title: Rosemary Scalp Serum
products.description: A lightweight leave-in serum with rosemary and peptides, applied directly to the parting each night. Non-greasy, so it works on days you are not washing.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Rosmarinus officinalis leaf extract, niacinamide, acetyl tetrapeptide-3, Trifolium pratense extract, panthenol, caffeine.

products.title: Amla & Hibiscus Hair Mask
products.description: A weekly deep-conditioning mask of amla and hibiscus for hair that has gone brittle from heat or hard water. Twenty minutes on damp mid-lengths, then rinse.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Emblica officinalis fruit extract, Hibiscus rosa-sinensis flower extract, Butyrospermum parkii, cetearyl alcohol, hydrolysed keratin, Argania spinosa oil.

products.title: Gentle Foaming Cleanser
products.description: A pH-balanced morning and evening cleanser that removes sunscreen and city grime without the tight, squeaky feeling. Safe alongside actives.
products.ingredients: Aqua, coco-glucoside, glycerin, Centella asiatica extract, allantoin, sodium PCA, panthenol.

products.title: Niacinamide Clarity Serum
products.description: Ten percent niacinamide with zinc, for congested skin and the marks left behind after a breakout. Use in the morning under sunscreen.
products.ingredients: Aqua, niacinamide 10%, zinc PCA, Centella asiatica, hyaluronic acid, panthenol, allantoin.

products.title: Vitamin C Glow Serum
products.description: A stabilised 15% vitamin C with ferulic acid, for uneven tone and early pigmentation. Morning use, always followed by sunscreen.
products.ingredients: Aqua, ethyl ascorbic acid 15%, ferulic acid, tocopherol, Citrus limon extract, glycerin, sodium hyaluronate.

products.title: Ceramide Repair Serum
products.description: A barrier-repair serum with a 3:1:1 ceramide complex, for skin left sensitised by retinol or over-exfoliation. Apply at night; alternate evenings if you are also using retinol.
products.ingredients: Aqua, ceramide NP, ceramide AP, ceramide EOP, phytosphingosine, cholesterol, squalane, sodium hyaluronate, Centella asiatica.

products.title: Tinted Mineral SPF 50
products.description: A zinc-based SPF 50 with a universal warm tint that suits light to medium-deep skin. No white cast, and it sits well under makeup.
products.ingredients: Aqua, zinc oxide 22%, iron oxides, niacinamide, Butyrospermum parkii, tocopherol, silica.

products.title: Biotin Hair & Nail Gummies
products.description: Two gummies a day for biotin, zinc and folate. Aimed at hair that has thinned after illness, stress or a hard year.
products.ingredients: Biotin 5000mcg, zinc gluconate, folic acid, vitamin E, vitamin B12, pectin, natural orange flavour, cane sugar.

products.title: Ashwagandha Calm Capsules
products.description: KSM-66 ashwagandha root extract, standardised to 5% withanolides. One capsule after dinner for sleep quality and everyday stress load.
products.ingredients: Withania somnifera root extract (KSM-66) 600mg, black pepper extract, vegetarian HPMC capsule.

products.title: Triphala Gut & Glow Powder
products.description: The classical three-fruit blend, stone-ground. One teaspoon in warm water before bed, for digestion and the skin clarity that follows from it.
products.ingredients: Emblica officinalis, Terminalia bellirica, Terminalia chebula, in equal parts. Nothing else.
